outcome.answer: Yes: the closest match is [7], which proposes AMuFC, a modular fact-checking framework that adaptively decides whether visual evidence should be used, because the paper shows that using visual evidence indiscriminately can reduce verification accuracy. [7] None of the other supplied papers directly focus on deciding whether an image is helpful or harmful for verification; instead, they mainly verify image-text claims with retrieval, evidence fusion, or explanation generation [1, 2, 8].
